trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy across the single-player list; the platinum is the final cleanup reward. No separate online trophies are listed. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening main mission Gone Fishing through its completion screen. This is an automatic story unlock and is not reported missable. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 story arc. Keep an eye on the separate meditation warning below before leaving this chapter. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance the main missions until Chapter 2 closes. Side content is not required for this chapter award. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story missions to receive the chapter award. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story missions. Preserve a rotating manual save before major chapter transitions because missions cannot be replayed. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign’s final mission. Free roam is reported to continue afterward, so leave exploration and checklist cleanup for later if desired. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run when it becomes available in the story. Mission awards are automatic on completion. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist as part of the story. The trophy is tied to completing the named mission. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child’s Play when the campaign reaches it; this is a story mission completion award. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners during the main story. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown during the main story. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory during the main story. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, use Progress → 100% Completion as the authoritative checklist. PowerPyx reports this is a curated checklist, not every activity: examples include 100 optional tasks, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 70 of 80 challenges, and selected collectible/side activity targets. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 tracked stunts. Use Progress → Activities → Stunts to see the counter; jump routes, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. There are more than 250 available, so choose the types you are comfortable with. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game’s nine activity types once. Start activities from map markers and check the activity counter after each; this is a broad sampler, not nine wins. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges at Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero). Map → Activities → Shooting Ranges shows locked challenges and progress. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Find them in Activities → Drones → Top Fun Drones; some have an entry fee. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events; replaying one race does not add another. Track discovered events in Activities → Racing and upgrade or hire a competitive car. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Accept Cal’s fishing request and beat his target: the guide says to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg in the marked area. Use a boat equipped with a rod, then keep fishing until the size requirement is met. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Finish its game objective rather than merely starting a cabinet session. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Andy’s strand; this award drops when you complete his final mission. Optional character strands can be completed during free roam. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton’s strand through its final mission, Maritime Disputes. Follow the strand markers and finish the final objective. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s strand through the final mission, Hometown Heroes. Follow his optional mission chain to its ending. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight different stranger mission strands around Leonida. Begin optional stranger chains as you discover them and complete each strand to its ending; the requirement counts strands, not eight individual errands. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Randy’s missions. The guide notes vehicle deliveries are part of his strand; use the mission prompts/list to locate the required vehicles. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Tyrone’s missions. The guide points to Kitty Litter Lab locations as strand progress; follow the map/task chain until the final mission. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate successfully at all 18 marked spots. A meditation only counts after its closing zen animation. IMPORTANT: PowerPyx flags Lucia’s first Chapter 1 meditation as potentially missable; perform it immediately when prompted, then finish the other spots using Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal requested by Bret as part of his quest strand. Start Bret’s missions, reach the marked hunting area, and take the specified animal; his strand is also part of the 100% checklist. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish all cards in any three collectible-card sets. There are 18 reported sets; the trophy does not require all cards in Leonida. Progress → Collections → Collectible Cards tracks sets, and collected cards may be sold without losing credit. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. Use the app on landmarks/curiosities as you explore; the cited guide lists landmark, curiosity and sculpture scans as eligible. Verify the total in Progress → Collections → WAiNK Locations. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 entries in Progress → Challenges. The guide reports 80 total and says 70 count toward the 100% checklist, so this trophy can be earned along that route. Source: Push Square — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, build a four-star wanted level, then evade police until the level clears. Use a fast escape vehicle and break line of sight; avoid being arrested before the wanted meter disappears. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three different shops in sequence while keeping the same active wanted level between robberies. Plan a nearby route and evade only after the third robbery; losing the level breaks the chain. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by entering or scanning them. New models count once; the Waink app scans vehicles and can progress the 200 vehicle scans used for 100% too. Check Progress → Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use Combat Focus when at least five enemies are clustered, then take all five down before the focus effect ends. Build the ability first and use a firearm with enough ammo. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, make an unscheduled departure: enter the airport area and leave without using the ordinary planned departure. The precise trigger is not described by the cited walkthrough; try an improvised escape from the airport grounds. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is cryptic (“Kinda hot in these Rhinos”). The cited guide list does not yet give a confirmed method; investigate the Rhino/tank activity and check the trophy counter after the relevant encounter rather than assuming a specific kill count. Source: Mobalytics (work in progress) — https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/grand-theft-auto-6-all-trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without raising the alarm or being spotted. Scout the store, enter quietly, keep out of staff sightlines, and leave unseen; retry from a manual save if detection triggers. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape alive from each. Track completed robberies in the activity/progress menu; plan an exit route before opening a vault and get clear of the search area. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept an armored truck, take its contents, then escape the police response. Keep moving until the wanted level clears; the trophy is for completing the robbery and getaway. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every named region of Leonida until the map registers all areas. Ride roads and shorelines through each fogged patch, then use the map/exploration counter to find gaps. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Find and rob at least one Illegal Operation for every gang. Search the map as operations unlock, complete each robbery, and keep a written gang checklist because the requirement is one per gang rather than nine operations from one group. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: On Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a venue with an ocean view. Let the drink interaction complete while positioned at the beachfront view. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom and force your way out using a vehicle in the classic smash-through style. The official wording gives the stunt but the cited guide has no precise showroom coordinates; try the showroom encounter and confirm the unlock. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley and complete a bowling follow-through/throw. Finish a turn so the game registers the activity. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is intentionally cryptic, and the cited trophy list does not currently document a reliable trigger. Keep this trophy for cleanup, review new guide updates, and avoid spending or progressing irreversibly based on guesses. Source: Mobalytics (work in progress) — https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/grand-theft-auto-6-all-trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description is cryptic (“Choices made (for better or worse)”) and available guide listings do not explain the trigger. Treat it as a hidden narrative/action counter; check progress after major choices and consult updated walkthroughs before attempting speculative steps. Source: Mobalytics (work in progress) — https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/grand-theft-auto-6-all-trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description only hints “Second time’s the charm”; currently cited guide coverage does not confirm a method. Leave it on the cleanup list and check an updated trophy guide rather than assuming which activity must be retried. Source: Mobalytics (work in progress) — https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/grand-theft-auto-6-all-trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description hints at an unusual encounter, but cited walkthrough coverage has no confirmed location or trigger yet. Explore stranger/event markers and check for guide updates; do not treat an unverified rumor as a step. Source: Mobalytics (work in progress) — https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/grand-theft-auto-6-all-trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee attack from a moving vehicle against a nearby target. Get close at low speed and use the drive-by melee input; the wording indicates a successful knockdown is required. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use contacts to launder marked bills until the cumulative laundered total reaches $250,000. Keep taking marked-bill jobs and completing the contact handoff; track the total before spending proceeds. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops. Purchases accumulate, so use clothing, weapon and other store purchases during the story and finish the remaining amount after; check spending progress if available. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every one of the eight garage properties. Save this for later when funds are comfortable; compare owned garages with the property list and buy the remaining locations. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten different vehicles through the Scooter Bros phone app. Use ten distinct vehicles and confirm each registration; duplicates do not meet the different-vehicle requirement. Source: PowerPyx — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
